name: codex-director
description: On invocation, first set up the current thread as the project Director: title and pin it with thread tools before any ready response. Project-scoped workflow for Codex worker coordination, explicit workflow skills, monitoring, research, oracle, review, goals, and evidence gates.

interface.shortDescription: Invocation starts by titling/pinning the current Director thread, then coordinating workers.
interface.longDescription: On invocation, Codex Director must first make the current thread the stable project Director: title it, pin it, and avoid ready/loaded prose until title/pin status is recorded or blocked. It then coordinates routing, planning, Codex worker threads, explicit $director-* workflow skills, signal-first worker callbacks with child-thread readback, helper/subagent lanes for non-trivial workers, heartbeat watchdogs, research, oracle checks, adversarial review, goals, git/worktree policy, and concise evidence reporting.
defaultPrompt: Coordinate this project with Director workers.
Audit active Director work from the ledger.
